title: Phyllis Schlemmer says Puharich used the TD 100 machine on her

tellings.quote: he used the TD 100 machine on me all the time. I never knew what it did. I never questioned what it did.

plain: On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, an unnamed researcher passes on what a woman named Phyllis Schlemmer said about the 1970s, when she worked with a man named Andrija Puharich. According to the researcher, Schlemmer said Puharich used a device called the TD 100 machine on her all the time, and that she never knew what it did and never asked. If true, it would mean she was the subject of experiments she did not understand.
